# OKRs — H2 2026

Outcome-oriented objectives for the second half of 2026. Confidence is Diane's read on
hitting target by year-end (high / medium / low). Confidential items use the code name only.

## Objective 1 — Bring Epic Phase 1 through stabilization without eroding patient care

| key result | baseline | target | current | confidence | owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cut open Epic command-center tickets | 1,240 (2026-06-28) | <300 | 610 | medium | Wei Chen |
| Recover ED median door-to-provider to pre-go-live | 42 min | 30 min | 38 min | low | David Coleman |
| Hold medication-error reports at or below pre-go-live rate | 22 / month | ≤22 / month | 25 / month | medium | Priya Anand |

## Objective 2 — Take cost and capacity pressure off nursing

| key result | baseline | target | current | confidence | owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cut agency/travel nurses as a share of nursing hours | 14% | <6% | 11% | medium | Karen Osei |
| Grow internal float-pool coverage of open shifts | 30% | 70% | 45% | medium | Karen Osei |
| Hold a weekly staffing huddle with unit managers | — | weekly | — | high | Karen Osei |

## Objective 3 — Clear accreditation risk and stage Lantern for a clean decision

| key result | baseline | target | current | confidence | owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Close June Joint Commission findings via an accepted Plan of Correction | 0 of 2 finding areas | 2 of 2 | 1 of 2 | low | Ellen Vasquez |
| Reach cleared-circle sign-off on the Lantern transition plan | 2 of 6 | 6 of 6 | 4 of 6 | medium | Sandra Kim |
